name: Through Gaze
description: Look through a disguise or a shimmer of illusion at the plain body that lies behind.

name: Seam Strike
description: Strike at the seam where an illusion meets the real body and not at the show.

name: Sight Guard
description: Turn aside only the blow that is real and let the phantom blades pass through.

name: Clearing Step
description: Step through a field of false images by the one path that is real.

name: Lens Focus
description: Gather the sight into a hard lens that sharpens every strike for a time.

name: Unmasking Palm
description: Press a palm on a disguised foe and tear the cover of his qi away from his skin.

name: Phantom Break
description: Break a phantom double into mist with a short hard stroke at its centre.

name: Revealing Ring
description: Draw a ring of clear qi round the user in which every hidden thing shows its form.

name: Sheer Thrust
description: Drive a narrow thrust of clear qi through a guard to the body the guard was built to hide.

name: Illusion Sweep
description: Sweep a wave of clarity across the whole front and strip every illusion standing in it.

name: Clarity Seed
description: Plant a seed of clear qi in the air about the body that opens into a field in a breath.

name: Clear Palm
description: Strike with a palm whose qi is so clear that the foe sees exactly what is coming and cannot stop it.

name: Clarity Guard
description: Thicken the clear field before the chest into a close shield that stops a thrust.

name: Honesty Mark
description: Let the field mark every body that steps into it and note which lie about their purpose.

name: Clear Spread
description: Spread the clarity outward so that the glamours and charms of those inside it fail.

name: Piercing Clarity
description: Cut along the edge of the field so the blow carries no shadow and cannot be read late.

name: Crystal Cloak
description: Wrap the body in a clear cloak that shows its wearer exactly as he is and turns blows.

name: Absolute Weight
description: Fill the field with a pressure of plain fact so that every foe in it sags under his own deceit.

name: Clear Survey
description: Open the field wide and read the number and the stance and the true aim of all within.

name: Pane Palm
description: Strike with a palm that shows the foe a clear reflection of his own pose a moment before it lands.

name: False Mirror
description: Hold up a mirror of qi that shows the foe a lie so plain that he laughs and drops his guard.

name: True Mirror
description: Hold up a second mirror that shows the user exactly what stands before him.

name: Twin Glass Guard
description: Raise two panes of clear qi before the body and let a blow break on the first.

name: Pane Step
description: Step between the two panes and come out of the other one a pace away.

name: Pair Verity
description: Hold the pair of mirrors steady in the mind until the body acts only on what is so.

name: Reflected Pretence
description: Turn a foe's own disguise back on him in the glass until he cannot tell it from himself.

name: Mirror Edge
description: Cut along the edge of a pane so the blow appears in both mirrors and lands in one.

name: Glass Ward
description: Hold a long ward of clear glass that sends back a little of each blow that strikes it.

name: Mirror Truth
description: Show a foe himself in the clear glass without his cover until he cannot raise his hand.

name: Shattered Pair
description: Break both mirrors outward in a spray of clear shards that cut all who stand before them.

name: Hawk Count
description: Look down from a height and count the foes and their wounds at a single glance.

name: Hawk Palm
description: Drop onto the foe with a palm that goes straight to the place he said was sound.

name: Pinion Guard
description: Brush a cut aside with a forearm held like the edge of a wing.

name: Injury Reading
description: Read the old and fresh wounds of a foe through his coat and his stance.

name: Aerial Reckoning
description: Rise on a light step and total the numbers and strengths of those below at a glance.

name: Claim Breaker
description: Hit the foe at the exact point where his boast of being whole is false.

name: Eyrie Fall
description: Fall from above with the foe's true weakness already marked and strike it with the full weight.

name: Wounds Revealed
description: Make every hidden injury in a group of foes flare so that they cannot fight through it.

name: Spoken Oath
description: Speak one plain oath and let the qi hold the body to it through the next blows.

name: Pledged Palm
description: Throw a palm that carries the oath behind it and does not turn aside.

name: Word Guard
description: Say aloud the one thing the guard will not let pass and hold it.

name: Bound Step
description: Take a step sworn beforehand and go exactly as far as the word said.

name: Honest Ear
description: Listen to the swearing of others and note the ones whose oaths ring hollow.

name: Troth Binding
description: Call the foe to keep a promise he made in passing and hold him to it by his own word.

name: Oath Cut
description: Cut where an oath has been broken and let the force of the broken word follow the edge.

name: Spoken Ward
description: Speak a ward into being that stands as long as the speaker keeps his word.

name: Sworn Fact
description: State a fact about the foe aloud and let its truth settle on him like a weight.

name: Word Made True
description: Say the blow and then make the saying true with a stroke that falls exactly as named.

name: Open Candor
description: Open the stance and the mind together and let nothing be held back from the next move.

name: Bare Strike
description: Throw an unhidden blow along a clear line and let it land on its own weight.

name: True Sounding
description: Take a sounding of the way ahead and learn which of the signs along it are false.

name: Unhid Guard
description: Turn a blow aside with an arm held plainly in view and no hidden second guard.

name: Refuge Stripped
description: Strip the cover and the false shelter from a foe and leave him standing in plain view.

name: Open Judgement
description: Pass an open judgement on a foe that he can neither answer nor escape.

name: Clear Sweep
description: Sweep a wave of plain qi across the open ground that carries no cover for liars.

name: Unwalled Verdict
description: Hold a verdict of truth over the field that leaves no refuge for any false claim.

name: Truth Crush
description: Bring the plain weight of what is so down on a foe in one open blow.
